description: Schema for the GitLab Dependency Management feature configuration

cooldown.description: Minimum number of days after a package is released before it can be used.

severity_level.description: Minimum vulnerability severity that triggers an automated upgrade. Findings below this threshold are skipped.

upgrade_policy.description: Highest version bump allowed when remediating. 'patch' allows patch only, 'minor' allows patch and minor, 'major' allows any bump.

open_merge_requests_limit.description: Maximum number of open merge requests the feature may have at once. Further upgrades wait until existing ones merge or close.
